newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn, soy values ease, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn, soy values ease, trade quiet.

text.p: Most U.S. Gulf FOB grain and soybean values eased in very quiet trading Thursday, export sources said.
The upcoming Christmas holiday on Wednesday has dampened enthusiasm for trading in U.S. and world markets and left dealings very slow, exporters said.
U.S. wheat continued to lose export business to countries with less expensive grain.
"The wheat market is just dead," and exporter said.
In export activity Thursday, Iraq bought 200,000 tonnes of French wheat and 100,000 tonnes of Australian wheat.
